about: Ideas pitched on The Yellow Notebook Podcast. 'quote' is word for word from a machine transcript; 't' is where it starts in the episode (h:mm:ss). 'who' is who pitched it. To add one, copy an entry and change it.

ideas.idea: Bring pop-ups back
ideas.quote: Bring pop ups back, baby.
ideas.note: The first idea ever said on the show. Andrew asked if it counted; Tim said this.

ideas.idea: Give your friends yellow notebooks and ask for their ideas
ideas.quote: I should just give some of my friends a notebook and tell them to write down their ideas and we should talk about it. And that's pretty much it.
ideas.note: Where all of this came from.

ideas.idea: Skip the five-star reviews. Read the three-star ones.
ideas.quote: Five star reviews. Who looks at five stars? You go to the three. You go to the third star.

ideas.idea: Take a laundry bag on holiday
ideas.quote: Bring with you a laundry bag. You can throw all your dirty laundry into there.

ideas.idea: Sporks should be three-fifths fork
ideas.quote: If you break up the name, there's two letters of spoon and three letters of fork. So it should be at least three fifths fork, two fifths spoon.

ideas.idea: Don't copy the login code. Memorise it.
ideas.quote: Don't copy that. Just memorize it because you need to work on your memory.

ideas.idea: Relief of missing out
ideas.quote: I'm crediting the Internet and my wife and some comedian, but I just really like that idea.
ideas.note: Not his idea, he says, but he's telling more people.

ideas.idea: The opinion curve
ideas.quote: I will have an opinion because it's fun to have an opinion about something that doesn't matter.
ideas.note: A U-shaped chart. Left side: aliens, toilet seats, sporks. Right side: things worth dying for. Middle: things you can just talk about.

ideas.idea: Draw pictures in the notebook
ideas.quote: turns out pictures are maybe actually worth a thousand words.

ideas.idea: No stock photos
ideas.quote: Do not use stock photos in anything you do, please.
ideas.note: There are none on this site either.

ideas.idea: Bring back seeded watermelons
ideas.quote: Seeded seeded watermelons taste objectively better than seedless watermelon.

ideas.idea: Put your glasses in the freezer
ideas.quote: Put your glasses in the freezer. Not all of them.
ideas.note: Drinking glasses.

ideas.idea: Houses should come with a map of the wiring
ideas.quote: if I just had a sheet that... Or like a plan view of my house that had this is connected to this and this is the breaker.

ideas.idea: Bible verses, out of context, as signs for the house
ideas.quote: I love the idea of taking bible verses entirely out of context and making signs for your house.
ideas.note: Example: "cleanse your hands, you sinners", in the bathroom.

ideas.idea: Cheer on people who act on their ideas
ideas.quote: We said that's a good idea. They believed us and now it exists.
ideas.note: About the sewing club, the first good thing to come out of the notebooks.

ideas.idea: Try a different opening every time
ideas.quote: I kinda like the idea of, you know, like, trying different openings is an idea itself.

ideas.idea: Find one thing that isn't an idea
ideas.quote: So we are looking for the elusive, ah, that's not an idea.
ideas.note: Still open.

ideas.idea: Keep a catalogue of every idea
ideas.quote: I will start a catalog of ideas. I'll take that on.
ideas.note: This page.

ideas.idea: LEGO instructions that make the set harder
ideas.quote: We'll make the instructions harder, and then we'll send it back.
ideas.note: Started by something Andrew said. Isaac added burnt edges, like a treasure map.

ideas.idea: Reminders to maintain everything in your house
ideas.quote: Maybe you have a roof.

ideas.idea: Drawers on the bottom, doors on the top
ideas.quote: You should just only have drawers on the bottom, only have doors on the top
ideas.note: His dad's rule. Dad makes cabinets.

ideas.idea: Something to replace drywall
ideas.quote: I hope that someone, someday, we can have a guest that has the answer to something that replaces drywall in houses. That's a plea.

ideas.idea: Turn the gym into a power plant
ideas.quote: You wanna turn a gym into a power plant?
ideas.note: Andrew's idea. That's Isaac cutting to the chase.

ideas.idea: A printer button that just stops printing
ideas.quote: How about someone invents a printer that when you're printing something, you can hit a button and it stops the printing immediately.

ideas.idea: Admit you make stuff up sometimes
ideas.quote: Just admit that you make stuff up sometimes. This is my idea.

ideas.idea: Colour-code lies
ideas.quote: So we should have a whole rainbow of types of lies.

ideas.idea: Always be learning one secret skill
ideas.quote: Everyone should, at all times, be learning at least one secret skill that they can pull out later at a party.

ideas.idea: Anything that comes in threes is a sandwich
ideas.quote: Anything that comes in threes is a sandwich. That's my idea.

ideas.idea: Idaho and Istanbul are on the same planet
ideas.quote: It feels like they are in different worlds, but they're actually... You could have someone going from Idaho to Istanbul.
ideas.note: Not an idea so much as a thought. Possibly the elusive one.

ideas.idea: Friday dinner: draw the restaurant out of a hat
ideas.quote: it's not what do you want I don't care what do you want it doesn't matter

ideas.idea: Mind reading is the worst superpower
ideas.quote: Mind reading would be the worst superpower.

ideas.idea: The fruit salad paradox
ideas.quote: the least amount of things in the fruit salad are the things that people really like and they fill it with filler.
ideas.note: Named while Andrew complained about mixed bags of candy. Andrew's add-on: get rid of Tootsie Rolls forever.

ideas.idea: Build-a-Bear, but a bag of candy
ideas.quote: build a bear, but, like, build a bag of candy.

ideas.idea: Grown-ups have to dress up too
ideas.quote: I think that adults should have to dress up if they're gonna take their kids out trick or treating
ideas.note: Robert went as a traffic cone.

ideas.idea: Ballots shouldn't be grey
ideas.quote: And I think the ballot is a simple place to start. Why is it gray?

ideas.idea: Make voting an event
ideas.quote: Maybe it's a pizza party.

ideas.idea: Community spotlight: Lee's Barbershop, Olympia
ideas.quote: He says, hey, how are you, friend?

ideas.idea: Jail for not returning your shopping cart
ideas.quote: You don't return your buggy straight to jail.
ideas.note: Also for not picking up after your dog.

ideas.idea: Coupling
ideas.quote: Reward is the generous brother of risk.
ideas.note: Ideas come in pairs. Nobody could follow it out loud.

ideas.idea: Maybe don't write it down straight away
ideas.quote: you gain some truth if you write down your idea right away, but you lose something interesting
ideas.note: Said on a show built on writing ideas down.

ideas.idea: Go to the funeral
ideas.quote: you should try to attend this event as much as you can.

ideas.idea: A scavenger hunt after you die
ideas.quote: After death scavenger hunt.
ideas.note: Clues that lead your family to where your ashes go. Robert called it phenomenal.
